facts.fact: Adam 收到 Jack 的短信：关于精灵宗教的资料已被全面删改抹除——不只是 Jack 的系统，而是所有地方，他只能找到角色扮演游戏的维基。
facts.anchor: It’s all been redacted, wiped. Not just from my systems. EVERYWHERE.

facts.fact: Jack 发来的 boggin 档案显然出自一位精灵之手（很可能是 Dautre），以极详尽的笔墨描述了这种生物。
facts.anchor: The pages of text, obviously written by an elf, probably Dautre, described the creatures in painstaking detail.

facts.fact: Vic 渴望有一个属于自己的地方，两人尽力攒钱，当前计划是先从一辆餐车（food truck）做起。
facts.anchor: Vic longed for a place of his own. They saved whatever they could. The current plan was to start with a food truck.

facts.fact: 矮妖精 Seamus 是「硬币之王」（King of Coins），统治西方 Watchtower；他虽不是 Adam 的头号支持者，却对精灵恨之入骨。
facts.anchor: The King of Coins ruled the Watchtower of the West, and while he wasn’t Adam’s biggest fan, his hatred of the elves ran deep.

facts.fact: Seamus 说那个正在逼近的东西比他更古老：他听过那首歌，它是一记警告。
facts.anchor: It’s older than me, but I can feel it in my bones. I’ve heard the song. It’s a warning.

facts.fact: Red Wolf 之所以不再向他的追随者现身，是因为 Adam 已在 the Between 杀死了他。
facts.anchor: The Red Wolf had stopped appearing to his followers because Adam had killed him in the Between.

facts.fact: Seamus 交给 Adam 一枚镍币，币面人像已被刻成一个戴高帽的粗糙骷髅。
facts.anchor: It was a nickel, though the figure on it had been carved into a rough-looking skull wearing a top hat.
